newsitem.title: USA: Primus sets IPO at 6 mln shares, priced at $14-$16.
newsitem.headline: Primus sets IPO at 6 mln shares, priced at $14-$16.

text.p: Primus Telecommunications Group Inc said on Friday it planned to sell up to six million common shares in an initial public offering at between $14 and $16 each.

In an amended U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission registration statement, the company said it would offer 4.8 million shares in the United States and Canada and 1.2 million shares in other countries.
After the offering, the company would have 18,028,746 common shares outstanding.
Primus will grant the underwriters -- Lehman Brothers and Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp -- an overallotment option of up to 900,000 additional common shares.
The company has applied for listing on the Nasdaq under the stock symbol "PRTL".
Primus, a McLean, Va.-based telecommunications company, disclosed the offering in an August 27 filing, which did not include details about the deal.
